name: Simien Mountains
about: Dry season Oct–Mar is best for trekking, heavy rains Jun–Sep make trails difficult.
overview: High-altitude trekking through the Simien Mountains, with endemic wildlife like gelada monkeys and world-class birding.
costOverview: The Simien Mountains are far cheaper than an African safari — a full plate of injera and wat costs just a few dollars, though every trekker pays the same mandatory scout fee built into each day on the trail.

costItems.label: Guided trek package, guide + scout + mules
